**Campaign IDs for reference:**

* 39ea0cd5151b54dc4b7057be  
* A6c0909a4feaec7995aef991  
* 551c33950def0cae080a702a  
* 160261631c0b3adffd0243d6  
* Game ID: 800078681, Name: Egypt Path (declined July 10 onwards and paused on July 16, campaignID: da21d1b440d1598cf69735da)  
* Game ID: 800084221, Name: Big Win Pick (new, launched on July 12, declined July 14 onwards, still active, campaignID: a6c0909a4feaec7995aef991)

[Imply link](https://internal-v2-1.pivot.int-prd-imply.unity3d.com/pivot/d/868e891eb77f9b6255/uAds_Demand_Supply_Internal_\(billing_&_finance\))

```sql
SELECT 
  date,
  source,
  Count(date) AS installs,
  SUM(post_install_deposit_capped_count_d7) AS purchase_count,
  SUM(IF(post_install_deposit_capped_count_d7 > 0, 1, 0)) AS payer_count,
  AVG(IF(post_install_deposit_capped_count_d7 > 0, 1, 0)) AS payer_rate,
  SUM(IF(post_install_deposit_sum_d7 > 0, 1, 0))  AS iap_count,
  AVG(IF(post_install_deposit_sum_d7 > 0, post_install_deposit_sum_d7, 0)) AS avg_iap_amount,
  SUM(IF(post_install_deposit_sum_d7 > 0, post_install_deposit_sum_d7, 0)) AS sum_iap_amount,
FROM `unity-ads-dd-ds-prd.user_value_incremental_datagen.unified_user_value_latest_prd` 
WHERE 
  date >= '2026-06-01' AND date <= '2026-07-22'
  AND audience_id in ("39ea0cd5151b54dc4b7057be", "A6c0909a4feaec7995aef991", "551c33950def0cae080a702a", "160261631c0b3adffd0243d6")
GROUP BY date, source
ORDER BY date, source
```

Average cost is steady recover when they increased tCPE again on July 19\.

#### Lingokids 500023036 and 500023036 spend spike

[Lingokids Investigation](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1W4KX_hBkJVhGepj-y1zMN1idmYt8x5KeVOLF-X2rCZM/edit?usp=sharing)

```sql
SELECT
    -- body.campaign_id,
    body.model_versions.adrev.version,
    MAX(body.target_game_id) AS target_game_id,
    COUNT(*) AS start_count,
    AVG(body.adrev_p) as avg_pred,
    AVG(body.adrev_adj) as avg_adj,
    AVG(body.adrev_value) as avg_value,
    AVG(body.cst) as avg_cost -- Removed trailing comma
  FROM `unity-ai-data-prd.mz_dcpi_raw.mz_dcpi_prediction_v1`
  WHERE submit_date = "2026-05-14"
  AND body.ar_ts BETWEEN "2026-05-14 15:30:00" AND "2026-05-14 16:15:00"
  AND body.adrev_p > 0
  AND body.co = "ID"
  AND body.model_versions.adrev.version IN ("unified-user-value-v14-mesh-v2a-20-model", "unified-user-value-v11-payer-v3-12-model")
  GROUP BY 
    1, body.app_event_model_version -- Use aliases/positions for cleaner code
  ORDER BY 
    1

```

```sql
SELECT
  submit_date,
-- Updated version logic using CASE and LIKE
  body.app_event_model_version,
  -- body.auction_id,
  AVG(body.app_event_p) as pred,
```

#### 500237245 Retention rate dropped day by day

* [Ticket link](https://airtable.com/app57RH2kwZZnaAqm/tbl7nKGKr8971nNBA/viwFuXkVYHUTuWIk3/recNSikEljaHSrgCL?blocks=hide), Matrix4Games  
* Model bias is stable. meaning model prediction is stable and accurate ([Looker Link](https://unitytech.looker.com/dashboards/13593?Game%20ID=500237245&Event%20Date=4%20month&Campaign%20ID=6971fadb477ae8984b9fe630&Target%20Game%20Name=&Platform=&Country=&Paused%20\(Yes%20%2F%20No\)=&Target%20Developer%20ID=&Target%20Developer%20Name=))  
* ![][image8]  
* Retention D7 at more than 30% in the beginning seems **unreliable/noisy**. The calculation is based on a few hundred retention D7 events.  
* ![][image9]  
* From Offline training data:   
  * No unattributed data sent to us  
  * The average D7 Retention Rate is around 18% to 20%. Meaning that as more and more scales, the average D7 Retention Rate will close to this level.  
* ![][image10]

```sql
SELECT
  date,
  source,
  Count(date) AS installs,
  AVG(IF(post_install_retention_d7 > 0, 1, 0))  AS retention_rate_d7,
 FROM `unity-ads-dd-ds-prd.user_value_incremental_datagen.uv_v26_q2a`
 WHERE date >= '2026-01-01'
   AND target_game_id = '500237245'
 GROUP BY date, source
 ORDER BY date, source
```

```sql
SELECT
  date,
  source,
  AVG(CASE WHEN post_install_deposit_sum_d7 > 0 THEN post_install_deposit_sum_d7 END) AS avg_pos_dep_d7,
  AVG(CASE WHEN post_install_deposit_sum_d3 > 0 THEN post_install_deposit_sum_d3 END) AS avg_pos_dep_d3,
  AVG(CASE WHEN post_install_deposit_sum_d1 > 0 THEN post_install_deposit_sum_d1 END) AS avg_pos_dep_d1,
  AVG(CASE WHEN post_install_adrev_sum_w4 > 0 THEN post_install_adrev_sum_w4 END) AS avg_pos_adrev_w4,
  AVG(CASE WHEN post_install_adrev_sum_d7 > 0 THEN post_install_adrev_sum_d7 END) AS avg_pos_adrev_d7,
  AVG(CASE WHEN post_install_adrev_sum_d3 > 0 THEN post_install_adrev_sum_d3 END) AS avg_pos_adrev_d3,
  AVG(CASE WHEN post_install_adrev_sum_d1 > 0 THEN post_install_adrev_sum_d1 END) AS avg_pos_adrev_d1,
  AVG(CASE WHEN post_install_adrev_sum_w2 > 0 THEN post_install_adrev_sum_w2 END) AS avg_pos_adrev_w2,
  AVG(CASE WHEN post_install_adrev_sum_w3 > 0 THEN post_install_adrev_sum_w3 END) AS avg_pos_adrev_w3,
  AVG(CASE WHEN post_install_retention_d1 >= 0 THEN post_install_retention_d1 END) AS avg_pos_retention_d1,
  AVG(CASE WHEN post_install_retention_d3 >= 0 THEN post_install_retention_d3 END) AS avg_pos_retention_d3,
  AVG(CASE WHEN post_install_retention_d7 >= 0 THEN post_install_retention_d7 END) AS avg_pos_retention_d7,
  AVG(CASE WHEN post_install_retention_w2 >= 0 THEN post_install_retention_w2 END) AS avg_pos_retention_w2,
  AVG(CASE WHEN post_install_retention_w3 >= 0 THEN post_install_retention_w3 END) AS avg_pos_retention_w3,
  AVG(CASE WHEN post_install_retention_w4 >= 0 THEN post_install_retention_w4 END) AS avg_pos_retention_w4
FROM `unity-ads-dd-ds-prd.user_value_incremental_datagen.v26_q2a_mesh_v2`
WHERE date >= '2026-04-01'
AND target_game_id in ("500263451")
GROUP BY date, source
ORDER BY date ASC, source
```
